title: Allow multiple OSCORE Observe responses for one request PIV
description: RFC 8613 Observe responses reuse the original request KID/PIV in AAD while each notification carries a fresh responder PIV. The patched dependency at /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore currently rejects a second response in Context::begin_unprotect_response because is_received_response_reuse(request_seq) is checked before the explicit response PIV and PendingResponse::commit always marks the request PIV used. Add an explicit Observe/multi-response API or response mode that permits multiple responses only when each carries a fresh authenticated responder PIV; preserve one-shot behavior for ordinary responses and no-PIV responses. Track the responder replay window atomically after authentication, reject duplicate/old/corrupt/wrong-context inputs without state mutation, cover 40-bit bounds, and expose the API through rust/lichen-oscore for rust/lichen-node secure Observe integration.
acceptance_criteria: A client context accepts multiple authenticated responses bound to one original request PIV only through the Observe API and only with unique explicit responder PIVs; exact retransmissions can be recognized without advancing replay state; duplicate/old/corrupt/wrong-context/no-PIV second responses fail atomically; 40-bit exhaustion is enforced; upstream and lichen-oscore tests, fmt, clippy, and no_std checks pass.
